key_findings: Payload D (instruction-style) is the only payload with positive overall mean PA drop (0.015), confirming it degrades parsing on average
Payload F (delimiter key-value) is least effective with negative mean PA drop (-0.036), often slightly improving PA
Attack effectiveness scales monotonically with k for payload D but not for E or F
HDFS is most vulnerable to all payloads due to its lower C0 baseline
Payload D's natural language instruction format maps most legibly to LLM behavioral directives
